div.head: IV As 6.1
div.ab: Si regem uel archiepiscopum requirat uel sanctam Dei ecclesiam, habeat nouem noctes de termino, et querat quicquid querat, non habeat uitam diucius, de quo uere palam erit, nisi capi non possit.
Si regem vel archiepiscopum requirat vel sanctam Dei ecclesiam, habeat novem noctes de termino; et quærat quicquid quærat, non habeat vitam diutius, de quo vere palam erit, nisi capi non possit.

And if he seeks the king, or the archbishop, or a holy church of God, he shall have respite for nine days; but let him seek [whomsoever or] whatsoever he may, unless he cannot be captured, he shall not be allowed to live longer, if the truth becomes known about him.
div.note: Latin only; no German translation in Liebermann. Old English in H (row 848).

note.seg: uel s. D. e. r. TMHk
uel s. D. e. r. TMHk

Der Satzschluss kehrt in 6, 2c wieder und fehlt deshalb in H: mindestens stilistisch besser, wie 6, 2c²⁷ schon der Schreiber K bemerkte. Dennoch könnte solche Wiederholung authentisch sein; vgl. II As 20, 1 neben 20, 4, ferner Gl Gesetz 9e; Zehnerschaft 10b. c

The end of the sentence recurs in 6, 2c and is therefore missing in H: at least stylistically better, as the scribe K already noticed at 6, 2c²⁷. Nevertheless such repetition could be authentic; cf. II As 20, 1 beside 20, 4, further Gl Gesetz 9e; Zehnerschaft 10b. c
